native_adapter_blockers: No native adapter exists for persistent cold ownership. The current observer window and outer nw_restore automatically restore power/common state; an explicit opt-in, single-owner retained latch must be set before first mutation and honored by all exits, suspend and handoff paths. A dirty or uncertain semaphore/MMIO result needs fatal stop/manual reset, never old teardown.

Before npc_run, prove exclusive WiFi-only first-radio cold state, WFSYS/BGFSYS CPU reset and power off, all other masters idle, AP CONN readable and chip ID 0x20010101, selected 26MHz and fresh SPM RC bit0. Map and own the entire SYSRAM 0x18050000+0x4000 plus exact host/CFG/RGU/RFSPI/AFE/thermal apertures. The source EMI remap must run before D-die, with separate MPU ownership evidence before firmware placement.

Implement ordered 32-bit MMIO, bounded side-effecting semaphore11/19 acquisition, reliable release completion, and TOP SPI transaction completion with no replay after an ambiguous trigger. Preserve fresh AP power/readability checks while safe; do not call any off-domain check after the final HW handoff.

Keep original PMIF/rail/clock ownership and input serialization for the retained lifetime; do not run the candidate in a concurrent worker.
